_comment: VS Code images scripts/build/shots.mjs cannot find in vscode/.shot-gates.json: the ones taken by hand, and the ones taken under another pipeline state (SF_MOCK_PIPELINE_STATE) then copied in under another name. 'file' is the name the harness writes, the key the name the labs use.

pipeline-branch-modal-uat._env_comment: The window of uat, which has no merge target before Level 3, so it shows its go-lives: the point is the uat box in devops-pipeline.png.

pipeline-branch-modal-level3._env_comment: The level3 diagram is laid out differently: the point is the integration box in devops-pipeline-level3.png, in window pixels.

devops-pipeline-promotion._env_comment: Lab 3.10: the level3 pipeline with enablePromotionBranches on and the promotion of US-057 open on the uat to preprod arrow. The promotion variant is a separate fixture overlay, so every other capture keeps a project with no promotion in flight.

pipeline-branch-modal-promotion._env_comment: Lab 3.10 step 4: the uat window with its checkbox column, five stories waiting, US-061, US-059 and US-057 ticked and the two others left alone. The uat node of the level3 diagram and the rows to tick come from promotionNode and promotionRows of the helios universe fixture.

promotion-create-select._env_comment: Lab 3.10 step 4: the command the Create promotion button ran, stopped on the selection to confirm, with the three ticked stories pre-filled.

promotion-create-conflict._env_comment: Lab 3.10 step 4: the same run stopped on the conflict question of the US-059 cherry-pick, the recommended answer first.

promotion-create-completed._env_comment: Lab 3.10 step 5: the end of the run, with the warning about the markers and the prompt report file next to the Pull Request button.

promotion-conflict-editor._env_comment: Lab 3.10 step 6: the Panel Batch layout as the promotion committed it, open in the editor with the Accept Current / Accept Incoming / Accept Both code lenses of VS Code over the conflict block.

pipeline-config-danger._env_comment: Lab 3.1 step 10 and Lab 3.10 step 1: the Danger Zone of the Global Pipeline Settings, where enablePromotionBranches and allowedPromotionSteps are set.
